Synopsis:
    The Shanghai Futures Exchange (via its subsidiary SHFE) is tightening trading controls on crude oil and low-sulfur fuel oil futures for October and November delivery, effective 14 September night session. Intraday opening position caps are set at 800 lots (crude) and 3,000 lots (low-sulfur fuel oil), with price limit bands widened to 16% and hedging margins raised to 17%. The move comes against a backdrop of a 7%+ weekly oil price rally driven by Middle East shipping route attacks and prolonged supply disruption fears.
